goal: Isolates node, wallet, and GUI functionality into separate processes
Prevents GUI or wallet vulnerabilities and crashes from compromising node consensus validation
reviewability: This pull request sits on open PR #29409 and includes its diff
agreement: Broad concept support for isolating node, wallet, and GUI processes (jonasschnelli, laanwj, jimhashhq)
Resolved reservations about adding the Cap'n Proto dependency (gmaxwell, dcousens)
Values running the node continuously while launching the GUI on demand (Sjors)

categories.name: ipc
why: P1 because it establishes architectural privilege separation between node, wallet, and GUI
Protects consensus validation from vulnerabilities or crashes in other components
Unblocks subsequent multiprocess integration pull requests
